text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU hotpath pool 'gp-hp-usw2' saturation — queue length spiking, 429s from inference tier: 12% over last 5m. Autoscaler failing to add new nodes (scale loop reports lock). Paging ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: I’m on it, pulling logs and metrics. tagging ashwin and maria for autoscale + ratepolicy.
ashwin: looking. I see scale controller errors: "failed to acquire autoscale-lock: token-window mismatch" — new ratepolicy change rolled out ~20m ago?
maria: that matches — we flipped tier-exclusivity for hotpath in us-west-2 at 09:12 to reduce cross-tenant contention. Might be interacting with token windows.
kevin: customers reporting elevated latency and 429s. Frontend shows queue depth > 350, normally < 30. Any temp mitigations?
jess: can we temporarily bump pool size and disable ratepolicy to drain?
ashwin: I'll try manual scale up, but autoscaler holds a lock so forced scale might get reverted. Attempting safe override: 
```
# tentative, do not copy to prod without review
redwoodctl pool scale gp-hp-usw2 --add-instances 8 --force-override
```
ops-oncall: Go for it, coordinate with maria so we don't clash with traffic shaping.
maria: also recommend increasing token-window and burst for the hotpath tier to avoid immediate token rejections while pool ramps. Current config: 
```
rate_policy:
  tiers:
    hotpath:
      token_window_ms: 1000
      burst_tokens: 5
      refill_rate_per_sec: 10
```
maria: propose: token_window_ms: 3000, burst_tokens: 20, refill_rate_per_sec: 25 — will temporarily reduce 429s while new GPUs come up.
r0: ashwin, any objections to temp policy change?
ashwin: fine as mitigation but we need to be explicit: change only in us-west-2 hotpath, annotate, and schedule rollback after traffic stabilizes. Doing change now.
sre-bot: deploy triggered: rate-policy/usw2-hotpath PATCH by maria. change id rp-2026-03-15-01.
ashwin: forced scale override returned: lock conflict. Autoscale lock holder: autoscaler-operator-47, last acquired 2m ago. Handoff to ops-oncall to queue a graceful drain and restart of autoscaler to release stale lock.
ops-oncall: restarting autoscaler on gp-hp-usw2 now (rolling restart, expect ~30s control plane blip).
kevin: notifying affected customers: priority A customers experiencing 20-30% error rate on high-QPS endpoints. Drafted message to support.
jess: routing: enable fallback model variant that uses CPU-backed instances for low-priority requests to reduce hotpool pressure? Can we toggle routing?
r0: we can enable a soft-fallback rule for tier=best-effort to route to small-cpu-variants. Applying now.
ops-oncall: autoscaler restart complete, lock released, scale override accepted, adding 8 instances. Pool size increasing.
maria: rate-policy change is live — token_window_ms=3000, burst_tokens=20. Monitor for token leakage.
ashwin: queue depth dropping from 350 -> 90 in last 3m. 429 rate falling. Good.
jess: customer mitigation steps: 1) support note sent, 2) fallback routing applied, 3) pool scaled + rate tweak. Recommend open page for postmortem.
kevin: agree, please capture timeline and RCA. Also include which deploy triggered tier-exclusivity change 20m prior.
ashwin: initial root cause hypothesis: recent ratepolicy rollout changed tier exclusivity and token-window defaults; autoscaler lock logic wasn't tolerant to concurrent policy changes and ended up with a held lock that prevented scale-up. Effect: queue grew, token buckets starved, 429 cascade.
maria: action items: (1) revert tier-exclusivity change for hotpath or re-evaluate policy rollout gating, (2) improve autoscaler lock expiry and observability, (3) add runbook step to temporarily increase token window & burst on hotspots, (4) support/customer comms.
ops-oncall: creating incident ticket INC-2026-03-15-001 and linking to this thread.
sre-bot: incident ticket INC-2026-03-15-001 created by ops-oncall.
kevin: outstanding: confirm no data loss, verify SLA hits, estimate customer impact window. Put an embargo on config rollouts for 1h.
ashwin: confirming no requests dropped that require replay; only rejections (429) occurred, logs show no internal queue evicts.
jess: I'll own the postmortem doc and schedule a 1-hour warroom in 30m.
ops-oncall: final check: 429s down to 1.2%, queue < 25. Keeping monitoring for 45m.
incident-bot: incident resolved -> monitoring. Marking as 'mitigated' — please follow up with full RCA. :white_check_mark:
